title: ClickUp 4.0 Just Changed Work AI Software Forever

summary.tone: A confident founder manifesto with launch energy. It starts with urgent pain ('broken', 'wasting our time'), moves through an origin story, and lands on a big category claim. A playful pun ('everything just clicks') resolves it into a calm, bright brand end card.

signature_moments.description: The words 'WORK' and 'TODAY' arc around a silhouette on circular paths, then a giant glowing 'BROKEN' behind the presenter shatters into shards on an impact hit (x001 at 1.65 s), all within the first 2 seconds.
signature_moments.why_premium: The opening is custom typographic design synced to both speech and SFX, not a stock title. It sets a cinematic standard in the first two seconds and makes the pain line physically 'break'.

signature_moments.description: A recurring device: a full-width gradient keyword ('BUNDLING', 'FUTURE', 'A LOT MORE') sits behind the keyed presenter, so his head occludes the type, while small supporting words frame him.
signature_moments.why_premium: The depth layering between talent and type is a high-end editorial look. Reusing it across the film gives the founder segments a coherent visual system in the brand gradient.

signature_moments.description: The finale zooms into a browser full of competitor tabs, closes them one by one until only ClickUp is left ('one app, one tab, one AI workspace'), and clicks a 'Launch ClickUp 4.0' task to Complete exactly on 'clicks'. It then resolves to the logo and the 4.0 lockup.
signature_moments.why_premium: It turns the convergence claim into a literal on-screen action and lands a word-perfect pun on a UI state change. That is a concrete, memorable payoff, not an abstract slogan.

hook.evidence: A four-word pain statement in under 2 s, backed by bespoke arc typography and a shattering 'BROKEN' with an impact SFX. It is strong and stylish, but a generic claim rather than a specific or surprising one.

clarity.evidence: The problem (tool sprawl) is very clear through icon swarms and captions. What 4.0 actually is stays abstract ('convergence', 'meta category', 'epicenter'), and many flash cuts (s012-s018) and dense multi-beat shots (s011, s023, s033) are fast. The demos show chat-to-task, AI agents and Planner but skim past each feature.

ui_showcase.evidence: Polished staged UI. Zoom-through pull-outs from the app corner (s026-s027), chat-to-AI-task creation (s029-s032), agents replying in the activity feed (s033), the Brain panel and Planner auto-schedule (s037-s038), and the tab-closing finale (s040-s044). Each feature gets only 1-3 s, so depth is traded for pace.

motion_polish.evidence: Consistently word-synced kinetic captions with blur-in, gradient type layered behind keyed talent, particle shatters, an isometric 3D tile merge (s023), timeline sprouting icons (s024), app-card ring (s036), and smooth zoom-through camera moves across the UI. Transitions use zoom_through and continuous moves, not only hard cuts.

sound_design.evidence: Judged from the anchor audio facts plus visuals; I cannot hear the track. The music runs at 143.55 BPM and integrated loudness is -16.84 LUFS. 74 SFX candidates over 116.8 s (about 0.63/s): impacts land on key moments ('broken' x001 at 1.65 s, reveal x042 at 58.78 s), glitch hits accompany the icon pops (x002-x005), and chimes (x072-x073) sit under the logo resolve. Many candidates are labelled 'music' or 'unsure', so how deliberate the SFX layer is cannot be fully confirmed.

vo_script_quality.evidence: Tight problem-to-origin-to-solution arc with callbacks ('root of the problem' w47-w50 and w105-w108; 'bundling' rejected three times) and a closing pun on the brand name ('everything just clicks', w309-w311). Some buzzword stacking ('meta category', 'epicenter', 'era of craft and quality') weakens the specificity.

brand_consistency.evidence: The pink-violet-blue gradient of the logo is reused for every hero keyword, the 3D slab, UI backdrops and the end-card glow. One geometric sans caption family is used throughout, a ClickUp watermark is in every shot, and the 'Introducing' lockup (s025) is mirrored by the final end card (s044).

works_muted.evidence: Nearly the whole VO is burned in as kinetic captions (s003-s036, s039), so the story reads with sound off. The UI demo stretches (s037-s038, s040-s043) carry no captions, so lines like 'saves you one day every week' (w266-w277) and 'one app, one tab' (w301-w305) are lost muted, although the tab-closing visual still makes sense.

overall.evidence: This is a premium, highly crafted launch film with distinctive typography, strong brand coherence and a clever finale. It falls short of a 5 because the product value stays abstract and the feature demos are too brief to teach anything specific.

localization_friendliness.notes: Every VO line is baked in as word-synced kinetic type. Much of it is composited behind a keyed presenter or layered into 3D and gradient effects, and English UI mock content (chat messages, tasks, tab titles) fills the demos. Localizing would mean re-timing and re-rendering nearly every shot to a new VO, and the closing pun 'everything just clicks' depends on the brand name in English.

annotation.focal_element: Black profile silhouette of the presenter in front of a soft circular gradient glow, with the words arcing around it
annotation.transition_other: video start (first shot, no incoming transition)
annotation.typography: Heavy geometric sans, all caps, white, set on a circular path: WORK arcs over the head, TODAY arcs under the chin; TODAY appears motion-blurred as it animates in. Small ClickUp logo watermark bottom-right.
annotation.what_happens: Opens on a silhouette against a blurred gradient orb; 'WORK' is already arced above the head and 'TODAY' rotates/blurs in along the lower arc, timed to the voice-over words w0-w1.
annotation.build_rebuild: Place a black silhouette PNG over a large radial-gradient blurred circle on black, render each word on an SVG circular textPath, and animate the second word in with a rotation along the path plus a motion-blur filter that resolves to sharp over about 0.3 s.

annotation.focal_element: Presenter speaking to camera with the word BROKEN behind him
annotation.typography: Very large heavy geometric sans, all caps, wide tracking, gradient-filled letters with a soft outer glow, placed behind the presenter (presenter keyed in front of the type). Shatters into particle shards.
annotation.what_happens: Presenter on black says 'is broken' (w2-w3); the word BROKEN appears behind him and fractures into flying shards, then by ~2.0 s the frame already shows the presenter standing in a bright open office (the sheet frame at 0:02.000 suggests the office cut lands slightly before the detected s003 boundary). An impact SFX (x001) lands at 1.65 s near 'broken'.
annotation.build_rebuild: Composite a keyed presenter over a large glowing gradient word on black, then replace the word with a particle-shatter (split glyphs into polygon fragments that scatter outward with random velocity and fade) synced to the spoken word and an impact hit.

annotation.focal_element: Presenter walking toward camera in an office, with kinetic captions and floating app icons around him
on_screen_text: people juggle so many different tools
annotation.typography: Lowercase bold geometric sans, white, tight tracking, words stacked in loose clusters in the space around the presenter; each new word blurs/scales in while older words fade and blur out; 'tools' and 'done' rendered with a blue-to-pink gradient fill as emphasis words.
annotation.what_happens: Handheld walk-and-talk in an open office while the voice-over (w4-w16) is captioned word by word; app tiles (Google Drive, Microsoft Teams, Gmail, Google Meet, Google Calendar) pop in and drift around the frame, some entering large and close to camera from the edges, illustrating tool overload. Several glitch-like SFX (x002-x005) and a reverse swoosh (x006) accompany the pops.
annotation.build_rebuild: Over a tracked presenter plate, reveal each transcript word at its word timestamp with a blur-to-sharp scale-in, fade earlier words to 40% opacity with blur, and spawn rounded-square app icons with a soft drop shadow that pop in with spring overshoot and drift at different depths to fake parallax.

annotation.focal_element: Extreme close-up of the presenter's face in glasses, looking down to the right

annotation.what_happens: Cinematic shallow-depth close-up on the presenter's face while 'a simple task' (w17-w19) types on word by word in the negative space at left.
annotation.build_rebuild: Use a shallow-focus close-up plate and add left-aligned white captions in the left third that reveal word by word at each word's start time with a quick fade-up.

annotation.focal_element: Close-up of a smartwatch on the presenter's wrist, then hands on a mechanical keyboard
annotation.typography: 'turns into' in lowercase bold geometric sans, white, left third; 'TIME' in all caps of the same family, centred above the keyboard.
annotation.what_happens: Wrist close-up checking a watch while 'turns into' (w20-w21) is captioned, then the picture changes within this detected shot to a low-angle keyboard close-up with 'TIME' appearing (w23); the second angle appears to be an undetected cut. A chime SFX (x009) lands around 8.62 s.
annotation.build_rebuild: Cut between two shallow-focus B-roll inserts (watch, keyboard) on the spoken words and swap the caption style from lowercase left-aligned to an all-caps centred word when the scene changes.

annotation.focal_element: Hands typing on a mechanical keyboard with stacked caption words over it
annotation.typography: All-caps bold geometric sans, white, stacked centred; each new word lands large and the stack then scales down and re-centres as the next word arrives.
annotation.what_happens: Keyboard B-roll continues while 'time-consuming mess' (w23-w25) builds as a stacked all-caps word list that rescales on each entry; at the end of the shot (around 10.0 s) the frame switches to a dark screen with greyed app icons (an OpenAI-style knot, GitHub) and a mouse cursor, which appears to be the start of the next sequence rather than part of this shot.

annotation.focal_element: A large white arrow cursor in the centre between two dimmed, desaturated app-icon tiles (an AI-chat icon left, a code-host icon right with a red '0' notification badge).
annotation.what_happens: A very brief beat (about a third of a second, over w26-w27 'because Work') on a near-black background: greyed-out app icons sit quietly, a red badge reads 0 and a third tile is cut off at the bottom right, setting up the notification explosion of the next shot. Only the persistent corner ClickUp watermark is visible as text (not listed).
annotation.build_rebuild: On a #000-ish full-frame background, place two 140px rounded-square app icons at 40% opacity with grayscale filter, a centred white cursor sprite and a red circular badge reading 0, hold for ~8 frames then hard-cut.

annotation.focal_element: Giant two-line headline 'WORK SPRAWL' with a pink-to-violet-to-blue gradient fill and soft glow, overlaid by a swarm of app icons with climbing red notification badges.
annotation.typography: Headline: geometric sans, extra-bold, all caps, very large, tight tracking, gradient fill with outer glow, stacked two lines. Captions: same family, bold, lowercase sentence case, white, centred under the headline, swapped phrase by phrase in sync with the VO; outgoing phrase blurs/dims as the next one sharpens. Font guess (low confidence): a geometric grotesk such as Plus Jakarta Sans.
annotation.what_happens: As the VO says 'Work Sprawl has scattered the tools and contexts we rely on' (w27-w37), app icons (mail, AI chat, code host, video meeting, design tool, team chat, cloud drive) pop in around and over the headline while their red badges count up rapidly (roughly 1 to 24 across the shot), large icons enter from the frame edges at different scales, and a cursor darts between them clicking; the caption phrase under the headline changes with each spoken phrase, then the composition slightly pulls back toward the end.
annotation.build_rebuild: Render a centred two-line gradient headline with a blurred duplicate behind it for glow, spawn 8-10 rounded app-icon cards with staggered pop-in (scale 0.6 to 1 with overshoot) and per-icon red badges whose integers increment every ~120ms, animate a cursor between icons, and swap a white caption line under the headline on each VO phrase with a blur-out/blur-in.

annotation.focal_element: Presenter (man with glasses in a patterned purple shirt) on the right-centre third against a black studio background, with words appearing in the upper-left negative space.

annotation.typography: Lead-in lines in bold white lowercase sans; 'BUNDLING' in extra-bold all caps with pink-to-blue gradient and 'SOFTWARE' in white all caps, both large. annotation.composition_other: Shifts within the shot: centred orb with flanking words, then centred word in a particle field, then presenter centred with split words left/right, then a giant year behind the presenter, then centred captions over full-bleed monochrome photos.
annotation.focal_element: The shattering app sphere and the gradient keywords ('SYSTEM'S', 'TIME.', '2017') that punctuate the presenter's lines.
annotation.transition_other: Detector flagged a non-hard-cut change; the sphere from s010 shrinks and continues into this shot while 'problem' blurs out, reading as a continuous scale/blur hand-off.
annotation.typography: Mixed: small white all-caps sans for 'THE' and 'BROKEN'; 'SYSTEM'S' and 'TIME.' in bold all caps with pink-violet-blue gradient and glow; 'wasting our' bold white lowercase stacked, left of presenter; '2017' huge extra-bold gradient numerals behind the presenter; '8 YEARS AGO' white bold caps at the bottom (partly occluded); 'we started' and 'with the mission:' small white lowercase captions; 'clickup' is the logo printed on a T-shirt in the footage.
annotation.what_happens: A multi-beat montage in one detected shot over w50-w67: the icon sphere shrinks between 'THE' and 'SYSTEM'S', bursts into a confetti-like particle field with the icons flying outward around the word 'BROKEN' (w51-w53); the presenter returns with 'wasting our' left and gradient 'TIME.' right (w55-w58); a giant gradient '2017' appears behind him with an '8' counter becoming '8 YEARS AGO' (w59-w61); then black with 'we started', grayscale footage of a person in a ClickUp shirt ('we started ClickUp', w62-w64) and a grayscale team photo at a booth with 'with the mission:' appearing word by word (w65-w67). Many internal changes (4 events in anchors) are too fast to confirm at 2 fps.
annotation.build_rebuild: Sequence these sub-beats on VO word timestamps: scale the icon orb to 40% then replace it with a particle burst (300 small gradient shards with outward velocity and fade) while the icons fly to the edges; cut to presenter with left/right caption blocks; place a large gradient '2017' text layer behind a rotoscoped presenter; finish with grayscale photo plates under centred word-by-word white captions.

annotation.typography: Geometric sans, bold, ALL CAPS, slightly tight tracking, large centred single word; font guess (low confidence): Plus Jakarta Sans or similar geometric grotesk

annotation.focal_element: An isometric 3D platform slab that gains four glowing product tiles (Chat, Project Management, AI, Knowledge Management) and then merges into one gradient ClickUp slab
annotation.typography: Two type tiers. Word-by-word captions in a white bold rounded geometric sans, sentence case, placed at scattered positions (lower-centre, top-left, side columns). Keywords ('PROBLEM,', 'POWERFUL PRIMITIVES') are set huge in all-caps with a horizontal gradient fill and outer glow, sitting behind the 3D object. 'MULTIPLE' is all-caps with heavy motion blur. The closing captions are stacked centred lines on black. The tile labels are tiny, rotated to the isometric plane.
annotation.what_happens: Within one shot (9.3 s, w102-w130): the presenter, filmed against black, speaks while captions build ('To solve the', 'Root of the'). A gradient 'PROBLEM,' rises behind him and then fades as a dark isometric slab replaces him. 'we built a single' and 'flexible' sit either side of the slab. Four coloured tiles drop onto it one after another. 'POWERFUL' and then 'PRIMITIVES' fill the background in giant gradient caps. The tiles merge into a single gradient slab carrying the ClickUp mark ('that can be shared to'), which pushes in while 'MULTIPLE' blurs past. The shot ends on black with stacked centred kinetic captions 'first class products' and 'inside of one'. Anchors report 1 event.
annotation.build_rebuild: Build an isometric rounded-box mesh with an emissive edge glow, drop four labelled coloured tiles onto it with a staggered ease-out, then morph them into one gradient top face with the logo. Behind it, put giant gradient uppercase keywords; in front, place word-timed white captions.

annotation.focal_element: The word 'CONVERGENCE' in a glowing gradient, centred after the ClickUp logomark badge resolves, followed by a scrolling glowing timeline that sprouts app icons
annotation.typography: White bold rounded geometric sans in sentence case, with tight tracking and words entering one at a time. Hero words ('CONVERGENCE', 'NEW WAY') are all-caps with a multicolour horizontal gradient and a soft outer glow; 'NEW WAY' is set huge behind the presenter. In 'deliver / products' the two words are stacked small either side of a white bar. The final caption 'everything we've built has' is a right-aligned stack on the left of frame.
annotation.what_happens: Long kinetic sequence (11.5 s, w132-w165). The ClickUp logomark badge appears centred on black, and 'we call this' builds under it. A cut to 'CONVERGENCE' in gradient follows, then a small dot turns into a white bar as 'it's allowed us to deliver products' slides left with motion blur. The bar becomes a glowing horizontal timeline whose stems sprout app icons while the camera pans left (calendar '31' icon at the end). The presenter on black then fades up behind 'and' / 'now'; 'we're tying it all together in a' builds in the corners and a giant gradient 'NEW WAY' appears behind him. A left-side stack 'everything we've built has' then 'led to' closes the shot. Anchors report 2 events.
annotation.build_rebuild: On a black canvas, chain word-timed captions: scale in a logo badge, crossfade to a gradient glowing keyword, then extend a white rounded bar from a dot into a timeline that pans left (motion blur) and pops icon stems on alternate sides, before fading in presenter footage behind large gradient caps.
